# Known Issues

- **Orchard-to-Ironwood spend is untested against a real Orchard note.** Regtest cannot hold Orchard notes because NU6.3 and NU7 both activate at height 2 (`packages/dev/docker/stacks/lightwalletd/zebra.toml`, `packages/dev/docker/stacks/zaino/zebra.toml`, `packages/dev/docker/stacks/full/zebra.toml`), before any block could pay an Orchard receiver. Verified: the Orchard pool chain value is 0 and the Orchard tree `finalState` is `000000` at heights 2, 3, and 113 (`packages/core/tests/logs/p4_followup_orchard_funding.log`). Under ZIP 258 ("Consensus rules from NU6.3 activation", Status: Final; quote verified line 101 in `zcash/zips`): "No new value may enter the Orchard pool: for every transaction, vOrchardPoolBalance >= 0 (so the encoded valueBalanceOrchard is nonnegative)" and "A coinbase transaction MUST NOT contain any Orchard-pool Actions; that is, its Orchard component MUST be empty." A funding attempt to an Orchard-only receiver produced 0 Orchard actions and 2 Ironwood actions (`z_sendmany` txid `e1850e719a5fa823c703e361899da40148c246165bfcd19eef4aa7796b001f62`). A real Orchard-note test needs both a Zebra activation-height change (so blocks mined before activation can fund an Orchard receiver and be spent across the turnstile afterwards) AND a change to `packages/core/src/consensus.rs` `regtest_consensus_params` (where `nu6_3` is hardcoded to height 2).
- **The empty Ironwood root the anchor check compares against is UNVERIFIED against the node.** `ironwood_empty_tree_root()` returns `ae2935f1dfd8a24aed7c70df7de3a668eb7a49b1319880dde2bbd9031ae5d82f` (`orchard::Anchor::empty_tree()`). Zebra's `z_gettreestate` reports **no `ironwood` section at heights 0-1** (pre-NU6.3) and a **non-empty** Ironwood tree at every height from 2 onward, because the first post-activation coinbase already carries an Ironwood action. The node therefore never prints an empty Ironwood `finalRoot` on this chain, so the equality is unverified by direct observation; the empty-node branch of `send()` is covered only by mocked tests. Indirect control: Zebra reports the empty Orchard tree at height 2 as `finalState 000000, finalRoot ae2935f1...`, byte-identical to the helper (`packages/core/tests/logs/ironwood_empty_root.log`).
- **SDK send tests mock proving.** `packages/sdk/src/send.test.ts` Scenarios 1-8 (including anchor-abort tests 5-7) stub `buildAndProveTransaction`, so they assert reservation, anchor, and fee logic but do not run Halo 2 proving. Proving execution is exercised by Rust integration tests (`packages/core/tests/transaction_test.rs`, `packages/core/tests/spendable_test.rs`) and live regtest pipeline runs.
- **Zaino `feat/nu7` experimental tier (pin `aaf8122a703704e05147d984f08ff82c789860ad`).** Zaino's published crates and upstream `dev` branch still carry placeholder branch ID `0xfffffffe` and `feat/nu7` is not merged into `dev`; no release has been published after 0.10.2 (checked 2026-11-11). Branch `feat/nu7` supports NU7 consensus branch ID `0x77190ad9` (built on `zebra-chain 15 / zebra-state 16 / zebra-rpc 19`), but is unreleased upstream. Running `zcash-dev regtest up --stack zaino` compiles Zaino from source in Docker using Rust 1.96.0, taking 524.8 s (8.7 minutes) on initial build (`packages/core/tests/logs/regtest_zaino_live.log`). The stack runs in RPC backend mode only (connecting to Zebra's JSON-RPC) with plain-text unencrypted gRPC (`no_tls_use_unencrypted_traffic`), bound to `127.0.0.1:38137` on the host. It is strictly experimental, REGTEST ONLY, and never the default.
- **Testnet initial wallet sync duration (measured 2026-10-26 on v0.1.0-alpha, first-sync from activation height 4,134,000 to tip 4,542,475).** A fresh wallet syncing against public gRPC lightwalletd (`https://testnet.zec.rocks:443`) takes ~22.6 minutes (1,355.5 seconds) to scan 408,475 blocks at an average throughput of ~301.3 blocks/s with 1,000-block batch size and 50 ms throttle pause. Transient HTTP/2 stream drops (`13 INTERNAL: unexpected EOF`) require client retry handling. Full benchmark proof is saved in `packages/core/tests/logs/wallet_b_first_sync.log`.
- **Zallet v0.1.0-beta.4 standalone Zebra backend spike on NU7 regtest (`zodlinc/zallet@sha256:682ba6f9…`).** Verified in `packages/core/tests/logs/zallet_nu7_spike.log` (reproducible configuration committed under `packages/dev/docker/spikes/zallet-beta4/`): Zallet v0.1.0-beta.4 paired directly with Zebra 7.0.0 (configured with `indexer_listen_addr` and shared state volume) successfully follows NU7 regtest, detects Ironwood outputs in `z_listunspent`, and builds/Halo 2 proves/broadcasts v6 Ironwood transactions via `z_sendmany` (txid `30c108ab1881fc8c945f37fb96d4c478230d25c6e951fc402d3b33961769b558`). Running Zallet in Docker requires an explicit `/tmp` tmpfs mount (`--tmpfs /tmp`) for RocksDB secondary state directory creation (otherwise failing with `NotFound (os error 2)`), and `--user 0:0` to read the shared RocksDB state volume owned by Zebra (`UID 10001`).
- **Zallet `z_listtransactions` memo parsing failure (`InvalidUtf8`, Zallet #794).** `z_listtransactions` is experimental and fails when reading notes whose memos contain arbitrary non-UTF-8 bytes (such as coinbase notes):
  ```json
  {
    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
    "error": {
      "code": -20,
      "message": "Data DB is corrupted: Invalid memo data: InvalidUtf8(Utf8Error { valid_up_to: 2, error_len: Some(1) })"
    },
    "id": 1793936876172
  }
  ```
  This relates to open upstream issue [Zallet #794](https://github.com/zcash/zallet/issues/794) ("Zallet reports incorrect insufficient balance and wallet DB has invalid UTF-8 memo"). While [PR #866](https://github.com/zcash/zallet/pull/866) addressed `z_listunspent` by omitting unreadable memos instead of failing the request, `z_listtransactions` was not patched and still aborts (`packages/core/tests/logs/zallet_nu7_spike.log`).
- **Zallet lacks `listtransactions` RPC.** Standard Bitcoin/Zcash `listtransactions` does not exist in Zallet v0.1.0-beta.4; only `z_listtransactions` is implemented.
- **Zallet `zaino` backend removed upstream.** Upstream Zallet removed the experimental `zaino` backend driver in v0.1.0-beta.4; Zallet now interfaces with Zebra directly via RocksDB secondary state access and the Zebra indexer socket.
- **Stock `zfnd/zebra:7.0.0` Docker image lacks Cargo `indexer` feature.** The official `zfnd/zebra:7.0.0` Docker image on Docker Hub omits the Cargo `indexer` feature flag. Zebra does not write the spending-transaction index on disk without `--features default,indexer`. Zallet reads an empty spending index when paired with the stock image, which disables transparent spend detection (shielded Ironwood notes and spends are unaffected as they are tracked through Zebra's core consensus trees).
- **Full stack indexer is lightwalletd (not Zaino).** In Tier 3 (`zcash-dev regtest up --stack full`), the light-client gRPC indexer on port 39067 is `electriccoinco/lightwalletd:latest` (v0.6.0), not Zaino. Zebra runs on 39232 and Zallet runs on 8182. Coexistence verification (`packages/core/tests/logs/regtest_full_live.log`) asserts `EXPECTED_INDEXER_VENDOR="ECC LightWalletD"` via `GetLightdInfo`.
- **Zaino direct state-reader mode is available only in the spike.** Active regtest stacks run Zaino in RPC mode (`backend = "rpc"`). Direct RocksDB state-reader mode (`backend = "direct"`) was tested only in the exploratory spike (`packages/dev/docker/spikes/nu7-stack/zainod-direct.toml`, `packages/core/tests/logs/zaino_nu7_spike_direct.log`, `packages/core/tests/logs/zainod_startup_direct.log`) and is not offered in the CLI `zcash-dev` stacks.
- **Full stack requires custom local Zebra image build (~8 min) and Linux.** Because stock `zfnd/zebra:7.0.0` omits the `indexer` feature, running the full stack requires building `packages/dev/docker/stacks/full/Dockerfile` (compiling Zebra `v7.0.0` commit `e8db87eb69254e0d4eedd058eadd48bdfa09065a` with `FEATURES="default indexer"`), taking ~8 minutes. It requires a Linux Docker host due to RocksDB secondary instance filesystem locks and container UID sharing.
- **Upgraders from alpha.4 must wipe regtest chain state and wallet databases.** When upgrading from 0.1.0-alpha.4 or earlier, developers must run `zcash-dev regtest wipe --yes` and delete existing SQLite wallet DBs (e.g. `~/.zcash-app/dashboard/` or project cache directories). While `@zcash-app/core` automatically migrates stored `'regtest-nu7'` database metadata to `'regtest'`, old chain blocks cannot be reused across the restructured stack ports and volumes (`CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/src/guides/troubleshooting.md`).
- **Zallet and SDK 110-note count equality is unexplained.** In the coexistence spike run (`packages/dev/docker/spikes/nu7-stack/README.md` Section 7; `packages/core/tests/logs/zaino_zallet_coexistence.log`), both SDK `syncWallet` and Zallet `z_listunspent` report exactly 110 unspent notes. This count equality is unexplained without a captured per-note txid and pool dump from the same run (e.g. Zallet lists the Sapling block-1 coinbase whereas SDK counts Ironwood notes only; set difference remains unverified).
- **No live mainnet read-only checks recorded in test suite.** While mainnet consensus branch ID (`0x37a5165b` at activation 3,428,143) and transaction expiry rules are unit-tested (`packages/core/src/consensus.rs`, `packages/sdk/src/consensus.test.ts`), live read-only queries against mainnet nodes have not yet been executed or recorded in `packages/core/tests/logs/` (existing live logs cover testnet and regtest only).
